title: Show HN: Oproxy – inspect and modify network traffic from the browser
summary: Oproxy is a browser-based tool that allows developers to inspect and modify network traffic directly from the browser. It provides a user-friendly interface for intercepting HTTP/HTTPS requests and responses, enabling real-time debugging and manipulation of network communications.
problem_solved: Enables developers to intercept, inspect, and modify browser network traffic for debugging and testing purposes without requiring external proxy tools.
why_valuable: Provides a convenient, browser-native solution for developers who need to debug APIs, test modifications, or analyze network requests without leaving their browser environment.
